description: A structured learning pathway covering the foundations, technical methods, and research directions of AI safety and alignment.
notice: This is a draft learning pathway for self-study and reading groups. It is not an official university course, does not carry academic credit, and may change as the initiative develops.

semesters.label: Semester - Spring 27
semesters.title: Foundations of AI Safety: From Zero to Breadth
semesters.description: A first semester for students with little or no background in AI safety. It starts from the basics of neural networks and builds a broad map of the field: why advanced AI could be risky, how modern models are trained, and the main research agendas (interpretability, oversight, evaluations, robustness, control and governance). By the end, students should have the vocabulary and context to read research, join discussions and apply for summer research projects anywhere in the world.
semesters.dates: Monday 11 January – Friday 28 May 2027 (20 weeks), with preparation in December 2026 – early January 2027

preparation.title: Before the semester
preparation.description: Complete the neural network refresher before the first meeting. The AGI Strategy course is recommended preparation: it gives the big picture the semester builds on.

modules.title: Neural network refresher
modules.description: Enough deep learning to follow the semester: what a neural network is, how it is trained, and how to run a small model in PyTorch. No prior AI experience is assumed; basic Python and school-level mathematics are enough to start.
topics: Loss functions, gradient descent and backpropagation
Tensors and basic linear algebra for deep learning
Training and evaluating a small network in PyTorch
